nodes.title: Asha's only fallback is her own look's rest still, under every look (r8 included): PuppetFace has no TutorFace path (phases poster/live/held), LessonFace reaches TutorFace only for a non-puppet tutor or the voice-only presentation, and the FaceSlot adapter is always installed (puppet off on the device → her still, not the in-house Plate2D). Evidence: docs/design/round7/face/r7-face-fallback-sheet.png (int/r6 showed a different vector face on puppet-off, no WebGL2, kill switch and pack failure; r7-face shows her still on all five paths). Supersedes holdsOwnStill (lamp1/lamp2 only). Reverse only if a look ships without rest stills (tests/r7-face-fallback.test.mjs blocks that).

lamp2 (painted mouth/eye/brow keys swapped, rigid head motion only) failed premium in every blind run over two passes: v3 (one mouth model sheet, breathing/translation life) passed uncanny 1, 1, 0 /5 but premium 2.6-2.8 vs r8 3.0-3.4 in the same runs; v2 uncanny 2/10 pooled; same person 5/5, childish 0/5; time box spent, held

lamp2 blind judges, 6 runs x n=5 (3 gpt-5.6-sol + 2 Kimi K2.6), lamp1 prompt, r8 in every run: uncanny 3,2,0,2,2,2 /5; premium 2.6,2.8,2.6,2.4,2.8,2.8; r8 uncanny 1,0,0,0,0,1 /5, premium 3.0-3.6; identical images scored 0/5 then 2/5

24-line Diya battery, product timing path into the lamp2 mouth keys: bilabial words sealed 132/132 with the lamp2 text rule (every b/m/p letter Azure left unsealed), 121/132 with lamp1's rule, 82/132 from Azure visemes alone
lamp2 key mouth vs the forced-alignment timing (E3, 21 lines): +55 ms median without a lead; with KEY_LEAD_MS 35: median +15 ms, IQR -10..+50, 57% within +-50 ms (continuous viseme jaw +10 ms, 95%)

lamp2 KeyRig (Canvas 2D, prescaled layer caches): 80 px row 60 fps at 4x CPU throttle, desk 375x405 49.3 fps at 4x (lamp1 10.5), headless Chromium; pack 133 KB wire; rest SSIM 0.989; keys SSIM outside region 1.0

src/face-puppet/rig-keys: KeyRig (a RigLike the unchanged PuppetDriver drives) + schedule.ts (viseme->painted mouth, 45 ms crossfade, 70 ms hold, own blink schedule, gaze key swaps, rigid motion caps); pack art/character/puppet2d/lamp2

A painted semi-realistic head may roll at most ~1.2 deg rigidly: at a 2 deg cap (J1-J2) and 1.5 deg + glance sway (J4) blind judges read 'proportions swim' / features sliding; at 1.2 deg (J3) uncanny 0/5

After v3 the premium gap is head motion: image-model 3-degree turn keys are different paintings (~40 px head move, redrawn features), so the next method is artist-drawn turn keys on one model sheet (cut-swapped on a blink) or a 2.5D/3D head in the option-4 look, not another polish of the key rig

lamp2 v3 blind judges K1-K3, n=5 each (3 gpt-5.6-sol + 2 Kimi K2.6), lamp1 prompt, r8 in the same run: uncanny 1, 1, 0 /5; premium 2.6, 2.8, 2.8 vs r8 3.4, 3.0, 3.2; moving photo 1, 3, 3 /5; same person 5/5, childish 0/5

Painted 3-degree head-turn keys from gpt-image-2 edits of the front: the repaint moves and rescales the head ~40 px and redraws the features (two bindis in a 50% mix), so no swap or dissolve can hide it; the flat-vector arm by automatic flattening (mean-shift + k-means) read blotchy and cheaper, not built

Weak devices and the start (face-puppet-raster-cost-main-thread): a static gate (src/face-puppet/lite.ts liteGate: tier.ts staticTier D, i.e. no WebGL2, software raster/failIfMajorPerformanceCaveat, known-bad GPU) never builds the r8 mesh stage and shows her rest still with a LIGHT MOUTH (4 pre-rendered mouth sprites from the live rig, public/face-puppet/r8/lite/, 15 Hz opacity swaps from her output meter); the live stage is ARMED only at her first audio (or an idle page outside a lesson, or 6 s); the governor is raster-aware (rAF interval p95 > 66 ms or >= 3 long tasks per window count as over budget; at the floor it falls back to the still + light mouth). TURN_HOLD_MS stays until the OffscreenCanvas worker (week 2). Reverse if the real-phone lab shows the gate sends capable GPUs to the lite path.

Start → first 'speaking' on /dev/desk?live=1, headless Chromium SwiftShader, CPU x6, n=8 per arm interleaved (evals/face-puppet/start-latency.mjs): p50 delta vs ?puppet=0 was +112 ms (n=6) before; after: forced live +44 ms, auto (gate → lite) +54 ms; long tasks in the first 6 s p50: off 976 ms, auto 1008 ms, live 2017 ms. A weak-phone proxy, not a phone; noise about ±100 ms at this n.

Asha's stills are rendered from each look's live rig (evals/face-puppet/stills.mjs: portrait, smile, resting, listening, thinking, curious, proud; eyes-open frame picked) into public/assets/teacher/asha-stills/1/<look>-<pose>.webp (NOT public/assets/gen/: the build's artMasters plugin drops gen/**), ledger public/assets/teacher/asha-stills/1/index.json with look-free aliases; teacherRecord ids stay teacher/asha/<pose> and the art loaders (App patch docs/patches/to-app/001) map them to the look the page paints, so the owner's lamp2 cohort sees lamp2 stills. Wave/reading/watering/telescope are stand-ins until painted pose stills (Azure image generation, needs keys). shared/tutors.js carries Asha's pronouns and stills record.

Her pre-rendered clips (public/audio/hello-{en,hi,hinglish}.mp3) ship viseme + word sidecars (<clip>.visemes.json) written offline from the clip's own audio by scripts/character/clip-visemes.py (greedy letter CTC, facebook/wav2vec2-base-960h on CPU, no transcript, no Azure; letters → the Azure viseme ids of the live path). src/face-puppet/clipBridge.ts puts them on the puppet bus anchored to the moment the clip's first sample sounds (re-anchored on play/seek, cut on pause); App applies docs/patches/to-app/003 (one call in src/child/voice.ts). Re-run the script whenever a clip is re-recorded.

Hello clip bilabial seals (evals/face-puppet/clip-seals.mjs: real Hello screen, prod build + App patch 003, live r8 puppet forced on, headless SwiftShader; a seal = min rendered lip gap within ±60 ms of each sidecar bilabial at most 15% of the open p75): meter path 12/34 (en 2/6, hi 5/15, hinglish 5/13) → sidecar 33/34 (6/6, 15/15, 12/13); open-mouth gap p75 9-13.5 → 18-20 rig px. n = one play per clip per arm; the sidecar's own bilabial timing is the reference (CTC-derived, not hand-labelled).

md.rejected:
## rj-r4-lamp2-painted-keys-premium
**Tried (2026-10-10, round 4 rig2, docs/design/round4/asha/rig2/):** the grown-up Asha (option 4, cardigan + print kurta) as PAINTED KEYS instead of lamp1's mesh warp: 10 mouths, 5 eye keys and 2 brow keys, each an Azure gpt-image-2 edit of the approved rig-b front, registered and composited only inside its region (SSIM outside 1.0); swapped with 45 ms crossfades by a Canvas 2D KeyRig the unchanged PuppetDriver drives; rigid head motion only (roll <= 1.2 deg). **Broke:** blind judges (lamp1's prompt, 3 gpt-5.6-sol + 2 Kimi K2.6, r8 in every run): uncanny 3, 2, 0, 2 /5 over J1-J4, the final build 2/10 pooled (identical images 0/5 then 2/5); premium 2.4-2.8 vs r8 3.0-3.6 in the same runs. Named: mouth interiors differ key to key (each mouth repainted from scratch), a still head, the thinking glance; more rigid motion (P3) brought 'proportions swim' back. Passed: same person 5/5, childish 0/5, rest SSIM 0.989, pack 133 KB, 60 fps at 4x on the 80 px row (headless), bilabials 132/132 on the 24-line battery (lamp2 text rule), calm safety face, lip-sync median +15 ms. Kill rule applied after 3 polish rounds; lamp2 is a HELD look, r8 stays live. **v3 (same day):** all open mouths repainted from one master key, a breathing / translation life layer: uncanny 1, 1, 0 /5 (inside the bar), premium 2.6, 2.8, 2.8 vs r8 3.4, 3.0, 3.2 in the same runs: still fails premium. **Reverse if:** a painted-key build passes uncanny <= 1/5 AND premium >= r8's same-run score in two consecutive rounds of the same panel (lead: one mouth model sheet sharing teeth, op-r4-asha-mouth-model-sheet).

## rj-r4-image-model-turn-keys
**Tried (2026-10-10, lamp2 v3):** two head-turn keys (prompted 'about 3 degrees') as gpt-image-2 edits of the approved front, to give the head motion without bending the painting. **Broke:** registered on the shoulders, the head moved and rescaled ~40 px and its features were redrawn (a 50% mix shows two bindis and doubled brows), so neither a cut nor a dissolve can hide the change (docs/design/round4/asha/rig2/evidence/v3-turnkeys-dissolve.webp). Also tried: the option-4 front flattened automatically into a 'flat vector' base (mean-shift + Lab k-means, 16 / 28 colours): blotchy posterised planes, cheaper than the painting (evidence/armD-flat-probe.webp); not built. **Reverse if:** an image model holds identity and framing to < 3 px on a 3-degree turn edit, or the turn keys are artist-drawn on one model sheet.
